answer: The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the shale queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 901 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the delta. A 415 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
